scientific_integrity: Two independent exact moment reconstructions and an exact global polynomial sign proof; symbolic checker supports but does not replace the argument.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-dimensional ABP, joint position/orientation Poisson resetting and matched angular/trap relaxation rates only. Third central moment sign does not imply distributional ordering, Gaussianity, or a thermodynamic phase transition; broader coverage/publication priority is not certified.
title: Unique stationary longitudinal-skewness reversal in a completely reset active Brownian trap
